context: V1 — profiled for diffing against BalancerPoolerV2 only.
purpose: V1 dispatcher that, on dispatch, immediately single-side-adds the received prime token (sUSDS in V1) as liquidity to a Balancer V3 pool via the vault unlock pattern, receiving BPT. Pooling is COUPLED to dispatch (this is what the V2 H-02 fix decoupled).
diffVsV2: H-02: V1 pools synchronously inside dispatch (every mint adds liquidity); V2 decouples — dispatch only wraps USDS->sUSDS and a separate pool(minBPT) does the LP add.
V1 prime token is the pool token directly (sUSDS); V2 prime token is USDS and is wrapped to sUSDS on dispatch.
V1 has no donation/PSM logic, no auth-version pooler model, no rescueERC20; minBptAmountOut comes from per-mint extraData.
V1 dispatch/unlockCallback are NOT nonReentrant (V2 adds the guard).

localFindings.description: Per-mint synchronous pooling with no reentrancy guard and slippage (minBptAmountOut) sourced from caller-supplied extraData — a minter could pass minBpt=0. Superseded by V2 design. Relevant only if V1 remains live.
localFindings.recommendation: Prefer V2. If V1 stays deployed, treat per-mint pooling as MEV/slippage-exposed and unguarded.

valueFlows: DISPATCH: prime token -> Balancer pool (single-sided), BPT -> this contract, per mint. withdrawBPT by owner.
invariants: Liquidity added single-sided each dispatch; BPT custodied until owner withdraws.
trustAssumptions: Balancer V3 vault honors unlock/settle; _minter trusted; pool/token ordering set correctly by deployer.
